key_insight: Quanifi turns quantum frameworks into reusable Apache NiFi components and enables NxM execution so multiple algorithm implementations can be tested across multiple quantum engines with clear fault attribution.
engineering_relevance: This architecture improves portability, comparison, and debugging of quantum software by decoupling circuit construction from execution backends and exposing cross-framework inconsistencies.
method: Wrap high-level routines from Qiskit, Cirq, Qrisp, pyQuil, and PennyLane as NiFi components.
Exchange circuits in OpenQASM 2.0 so one framework’s circuit can run on another framework’s engine.
Run every one of N implementations on every one of M engines and label results by implementation and engine.
evidence_signal: The authors evaluated Grover’s algorithm across three frameworks on three quantum computers and a set of three adder builders on one IQM device via two routes, which exposed three real defects.
watch_item: NxM testing depends on reliable OpenQASM translation and backend adapters, so parsing or gate-set mismatches can still produce incorrect results without obvious errors.
paper_title: NxM-Version Programming for Quantum Software: High-Level Components across Frameworks and Engines
